facts.current: As of Oct. 19, latest published JOLTS is August 2026, released Sep. 29 at 10:00 ET, USDL-26-1547. Table 1 seasonally adjusted total nonfarm openings (thousands): Aug25 6,919; May26 7,537; Jun 7,182; Jul 7,335; Aug 7,079 preliminary (change -256 vs July). August is 279k above the market’s 6.8m boundary. Current table provides only four consecutive months plus year-ago comparison; intervening Feb-Apr levels not included here.
facts.representation: BLS pages were read via web SDK; receipt hashes the serialized SDK result, not raw BLS wire bytes. Direct urllib HTTP retrievals failed with HTTPError and empty response bodies, captured under logs/deep_review_20261017/case0404_sources_20261019/.

facts.revisions: The August release revised July openings up 64k to 7.3m; current table gives 7,335k, versus July-report table’s 7,271k. Monthly revisions incorporate later respondent reports and seasonal-factor recalculation. First-published monthly estimates are preliminary; next month usually final. Annual updates revise prior five years of SA and NSA estimates.

facts.definition: Openings are unfilled positions on the last business day of month, only if work exists, the job could start within 30 days, and employer actively recruits outside the establishment. Openings are a point-in-time stock; hires/separations cover the month.

facts.sampling: All JOLTS estimates have sampling and nonsampling error. BLS generally uses 90% confidence (1.645 standard errors); significant-change tables test monthly/yearly changes. Median SE tables derive from five years of NSA monthly SEs. Current national XLSX link returned 404; exact numeric SE for this level is unavailable in this capture. Reliability page last modified 2024-06-07; standard-error page last modified 2026-07-22.
